title: Select
description: Native select with a hairline chevron and a fully styled dropdown where the browser supports it

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label linked to the native select. An instance ID is generated unless id is supplied.

props.name: autoWidth
props.description: Size the select to its content instead of the full field width; defaults to false.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes on the field wrapper. className, ref and native select props target the select itself.

props.name: children
props.description: Native option and optgroup elements. Selection uses native value/defaultValue and onChange props.
